title: Keep Features and Roadmap grouping independent
preconditions: A built feature and two planned features exist; one planned feature has two labels, the other has none; create a theme and milestone.

steps.action: Open each collection and inspect its grouping choices with and without a theme.
steps.expected_result: None, Persona, Label and Milestone are available; Theme is available when themes exist.

steps.action: Choose label grouping in Features and milestone grouping in Roadmap; open a feature.
steps.expected_result: Each collection retains its own grouping selection.

steps.action: Group Roadmap by label and count the multi-label feature occurrences.
steps.expected_result: The feature appears twice, once for each assigned label.

steps.action: Inspect Roadmap grouped by milestone, then label.
steps.expected_result: No milestone and Unlabeled headings remain visible.

steps.action: Rename the shared label and milestone, reload a member feature, and inspect its plan and navigation.
steps.expected_result: The renamed shared names are displayed.

steps.action: Set Features to label grouping and Roadmap to milestone grouping, then navigate into a story and back to each collection.
steps.expected_result: Features retains label grouping and Roadmap retains milestone grouping.

steps.action: Open each of those two feature occurrences and compare destination URLs and feature identity.
steps.expected_result: Both open the same canonical feature.

steps.action: Inspect the features listed under No milestone and Unlabeled.
steps.expected_result: The unassigned feature itself is visible under both applicable groups.

steps.action: In Features and Roadmap, filter separately by each renamed label and milestone name.
steps.expected_result: Each directory displays current names and finds matching member features.

expected_result: Keep Features and Roadmap grouping independent.
